datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2011, classifying geographic areas in Mali into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity. Data were compiled into spatial GeoJSON and KML formats representing snapshots at four time points (January, April, July, October 2011).
